purpose: Remove the room-level local-runtime restriction and test whether a measured conflict-resolution kernel is actually better before adopting it.

local_models: the room API no longer rejects a local runtime model
the room model pool keeps local and cloud routes instead of dropping local entries
the room turn no longer replaces a selected local route with a cloud provider
the room model picker no longer filters local providers
algorithm_evaluation: promotion now compares the winner with the active kernel, not only with the fixture baseline
the multiagent conflict fixture no longer labels the last speaker as correct when the evidence is on the first claim
owner-authority was measured as a candidate but was not adopted

local_room_live.room: one-agent isolated room, toolsEnabled false, autoLearning false, autoModels false
local_room_live.reply_quality_note: the 3B model produced one Korean sentence but the sentence was semantically odd; this probe proves local routing and execution, not local model quality

before_fixture_fix.note: the old rule compared the winner with the baseline (1.0), so it kept the 0.8 active kernel

algorithm_evaluation.decision: keep evidence-first; adopt the corrected evaluation logic, not the worse candidate

not_claimed: only one real local model (llama3.2:3b) was exercised; qwen3:4b and lfm3:1.7b were present but not run in a room
the local model's answer was not semantically reliable; this probe does not claim local answer quality
MLX was not registered as a provider; the local test used Ollama
the 100-turn Beam measurement is a separate long-running probe and is not included in these numbers
the algorithm evaluation is deterministic and synthetic; the real room conflict E2E was used to reject the candidate
